sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Safe is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 3x3 grid loot container that spawns currency, valuables and info items. The small safes on top of blue weapon lockers share the same loot table as the big black ones.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: The first USEC cottage safe and second USEC cottage safe on Lighthouse don't work like normal safes. Their loot distribution can differ from the list below.
